info.name: LDAP Injection in Login Endpoint
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The login endpoint takes unsanitized username input and concatenates it directly into an LDAP search filter query, allowing LDAP filter manipulation.

info.name: Unauthenticated Raw Database Vault Exposure
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The /api/raw-database endpoint returns stored database records, encrypted payloads, and creation metadata to unauthenticated anonymous callers.

info.name: Permissive Wildcard Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The Flask API is configured with CORS wildcard origin '*', allowing arbitrary external websites to make cross-origin requests.

info.name: Timing Attack in API Key Verification
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The API key validation uses standard string comparison (!=) instead of constant-time comparison, leaking secret length and prefixes through timing discrepancies.

info.name: Internal Network and Credential Hash Disclosure
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The /api/status endpoint exposes internal LDAP hostnames, ports, Base DN, and truncated SHA-256 hashes of secrets without authentication.

extracted-results: Fields exposed: ldap_service.host, ldap_service.base_dn, admin_secret_hash, active_secret_hash

info.name: Missing HTTP Security Headers
info.author: security-audit
info.description: API responses lack essential security headers including X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, and X-Frame-Options.

info.name: Container Process Running as Root
info.author: security-audit
info.description: The backend container executes the application with UID 0 (root), violating the principle of least privilege.

extracted-results: Missing USER non-root directive in Dockerfile
